messages:
sam-peopleops: Heads-up team — quick logistics check for today. Wexpect an early parcel drop (~10:00) and an external visitor (Dr. Mei Chen) at 10:45. Need: badges, fragile handling for demo crates, two quiet seats by the north windows, and a one-day hotdesk for a contractor (Priya). Can someone own?
reception-bot: Incoming scheduled: 8 parcels from "FragileTech" arriving ~09:58. Visitor: Dr. Mei Chen (External researcher) ETA 10:45. Badge request created for sam-peopleops.
leo-mailroom: Ian pull the 8 parcels and bring them to front desk. Locker #5 is free if you want them secured there, otherwise I'll hold at reception under "FragileTech" tag.
nia-facilities: North window seating is currently open until noon. I'll reserve both loungers and put a "Please keep quiet — Visitor seating" sign. Also can leave a small rope around the area.
kate: Ian print lanyards and a temp badge for Priya. Any special access for Dr. Chen? Lab or A/V?
sam-peopleops: Grant Meeting Room A + 2-hour guest wifi. Dr. Chen will have one demo crate marked fragile, and Priya needs general floor access only. Note to interns: do not move parcels to desks please.
tom-delivery: Scanned 8 parcels at 09:59, carrier QuickShip tracking QK-778. Applied fragile stickers to crate IDs FT-21..FT-28. Logging to sheet: https://intranet.redwood/shipments/1795556667
leo-mailroom: Parcels staged at front desk under "FragileTech" and one crate placed in locker #5 (locked). I'll leave a note on the desk: do not redistribute.
kate: Lanyards + temp badge printed. I'll leave the Priya hotdesk sign and a small sticky note "Reserved: Contractor Priya" on the desk. Facilities, can we get one extra chair?
nia-facilities: Extra chair dropped by 09:50. Rope and sign up. Please respect the quiet area for calls.
sam-peopleops: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist recap: parcels secured at reception/locker #5, fragile labels applied, lanyards + badge ready, north window seating reserved, hotdesk labelled. Tag me if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
reception-bot: Visitor check-in: Dr. Mei Chen signed in at 10:47, badge V-9901 issued. Thread closed.
